arguments.prompt:
Mobile login screen for DODOME, a French B2B inventory & maintenance app for restaurants/hotels.
Design: premium floating UI, glassmorphism, light mode. Brand colors: primary #6C8EA4, dark accent #102A3A, background #F7F8FA.
Layout: left-aligned editorial typography (large bold title "Gérez votre stock sans friction"), subtle gradient background.
Two entry points: primary black pill button "Se connecter avec email" and secondary outlined "Continuer avec Google" with Google logo.
Footer link "Créer un compte". French labels. No centered logo circle. Mobile 390px.
